diff.patch:
--- a/rc_gateway/auth/tokens.py
+++ b/rc_gateway/auth/tokens.py
@@ -41,9 +41,11 @@ def should_refresh(token: Token) -> bool:
-    remaining = token.expires_at - time.time()
-    return remaining < REFRESH_WINDOW
+    remaining = token.expires_at - time.monotonic_offset()
+    skew = min(MAX_CLOCK_SKEW, REFRESH_WINDOW / 2)
+    return remaining < REFRESH_WINDOW + skew
